label: D1 late in the episode (trials 80+), mostly after a reward
explanation: Reset-gate unit that fires only at D1 (never at GO or D2). Its rate climbs steeply with the episode trial index: about 1% before trial 50, 12% at trials 80-89 and 24% at trials 90-99, which hold about 75% of the activation mass. In the same way it tracks a low value-head output (60% of mass is in the lowest value bin), which likely reflects the shrinking remaining-episode horizon. It is also strongly modulated by the reward input: 86% of mass comes when the previous trial was rewarded. Weaker effects: a previous a1 choice and a rare previous transition each raise the rate by about 1.5x, and a previous a2 choice that went unrewarded lowers it. The largest activations come late in the episode on D1 after a reward, especially right after a switch that followed a rare-rewarded trial. The predicate uses only observed variables (the reward input and the trial position). Alternatives scored on dev: D1 & ep_trial>=80 got F1 0.61 / mass 0.75; excluding a2-unrewarded got F1 0.65; low value plus reward got mass 0.80 at precision 0.45. Many early-episode activations after a reward are missed, and late unrewarded D1s are only partly active.
